$comment: What Conversational BI needs from the host monorepo. Kept in sync with server/package.json by a test (depsManifest.test.ts). GC runs Mastra 1.32.1 on Node 22.13 or later, and this repository is pinned to exactly that set (see `mastra`).

@ai-sdk/anthropic.why: Anthropic model access (only used when LLM_BASE_URL is not set)

@mastra/core.why: Agents, tools and the HTTP server; needs Node 22.13 or later. Pinned to GC's version

@mastra/libsql.why: Mastra's own storage for agent runs (LibSQL file or in-memory); the chat history comes from the UI. From the same Mastra release as @mastra/core

dotenv.why: Reads server/.env in local development only

zod.why: Request, event and settings validation. Version 4: check GC's zod version before merging into one root package.json

mastra.why: Mastra CLI: build and dev server. From the same Mastra release as @mastra/core

mastra.rule: GC runs Mastra 1.32.1 on Node 22.13 or later; this repository is pinned to exactly that release set, so what is tested here is what runs in GC. The packages below must all come from that one release. Their version numbers are independent counters, matched by release date. @mastra/deployer, @mastra/server and @mastra/loggers are pinned through overrides, or the CLI pulls newer ones. Moving to another set: change server/package.json and check it with server/scripts/compat-check.mjs (docs/lift/MASTRA-COMPAT.md).
